dialogue.speech: Your face will be well-acquainted with it at the speed you're going.

dialogue.name: All
dialogue.speech: Yeah!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Good. We managed to lose him.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Now get us into the city andhead straight for the station!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Before he can catch up to us, we're going to get our hands on the thing and hide!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Giorno!

dialogue.name: Ghia
dialogue.speech: You're not getting away!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: There's no way you guys are going to make it to the station!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: He's freezing the moisture from the car's exhaust!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: What kind of temperature do you have to freeze it at to do this sh*t?

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: You b*stard! Eat lead again!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: He opened the trunk! Which means...

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Sh-sh*t! He got into the trunk! Stop the car, Giorno!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: He's gonna freeze the brake pedal so it'll be useless again!

dialogue.name: Ghia
dialogue.speech: There's no need for that...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Gunslinger Mista.

dialogue.name: Ghia
dialogue.speech: Seeing as Trish isn't here, this is what I was planning to do in the first place.

dialogue.name: Ghia
dialogue.speech: Shatter—

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: G-Giorno!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: It only cracked?

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: Is he invincible?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: How can I destroy this armor?

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Giorno! Get away from him!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: No! Not yet!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: We made it to Venice!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I'm diving into the canal!
